verses.geez: ወእመሰ፡ አርኀውከ፡ ሰማየ፡ ይርዕዱ፡ አድባር፡ እምኔከ፡ ወይትወሰዉ።
verses.translation: as wax melts before the fire; and fire shall burn up the enemies, and thy name shall be manifest among the adversaries: at thy presence the nations shall be troubled,

translations.lxx: as wax melts before the fire; and fire shall burn up the enemies, and thy name shall be manifest among the adversaries: at thy presence the nations shall be troubled,
translations.kjv: Oh that thou wouldest rend the heavens, that thou wouldest come down, that the mountains might flow down at thy presence,
translations.ron: Ca un foc care arde vreascurile, ca o vâlvătaie care fierbe apa în clocot, fă pe vrăjmaşii Tăi să cunoască numele Tău şi să tremure înaintea Ta neamurile, văzându-Te
translations.grk: ὡς κηρὸς ἀπὸ προσώπου πυρὸς τήκεται, καὶ κατακαύσει πῦρ τοὺς ὑπεναντίους, καὶ φανερὸν ἔσται τὸ ὄνομά σου ἐν τοῖς ὑπεναντίοις· ἀπὸ προσώπου σου ἔθνη ταραχθήσονται,

verses.geez: ወከመ፡ ይትመሰው፡ መዓረ፡ ግራ፡ እምገጸ፡ እሳት፡ ከማሁ፡ ትበልዖሙ፡ እሳት፡ ለፀርከ፡ ወይትዐወቅ፡ ስምከ፡ በላዕሌሆሙ።
verses.translation: whenever thou shalt work gloriously; trembling from thee shall take hold upon the mountains.

translations.lxx: whenever thou shalt work gloriously; trembling from thee shall take hold upon the mountains.
translations.kjv: As when the melting fire burneth, the fire causeth the waters to boil, to make thy name known to thine adversaries, that the nations may tremble at thy presence!
translations.grk: ὅταν ποιῇς τὰ ἔνδοξα· τρόμος λήψεται ἀπὸ σοῦ ὄρη.

verses.translation: From of old we have not heard, neither have our eyes seen a God beside thee, and thy works which thou wilt perform to them that wait for mercy.

translations.lxx: From of old we have not heard, neither have our eyes seen a God beside thee, and thy works which thou wilt perform to them that wait for mercy.
translations.kjv: When thou didst terrible things which we looked not for, thou camest down, the mountains flowed down at thy presence.
translations.ron: Despre care niciodată nu s-a auzit grăind. Nici urechea n-a auzit, nici ochiul n-a văzut un dumnezeu, afară de Tine, care ar săvârşi unele ca acestea pentru cei ce nădăjduiesc în el.
translations.grk: Ἀπὸ τοῦ αἰῶνος οὐκ ἠκούσαμεν, οὐδὲ οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ ἡμῶν εἶδον Θεὸν πλήν σου, καὶ τὰ ἔργα σου, ἃ ποιήσεις τοῖς ὑπομένουσιν ἔλεον.

verses.geez: እለ፡ እምፍጥረተ፡ ዓለም፡ ኢርኢነ፡ ወኢሰማዕነ፡ ባዕደ፡ አምላከ፡ ዘእንበሌከ፣፡ ወትገብር፡ ምሕረተከ፡ ላዕለ፡ እለ፡ ይሴፈዉ፡ ሣህለከ።
verses.translation: For these blessings shall happen to them that work righteousness, and they shall remember thy ways: behold, thou wast angry and we have sinned; therefore we have erred,

translations.lxx: For these blessings shall happen to them that work righteousness, and they shall remember thy ways: behold, thou wast angry and we have sinned; therefore we have erred,
translations.kjv: For since the beginning of the world men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, neither hath the eye seen, O God, beside thee, what he hath prepared for him that waiteth for him.
translations.ron: Tu Te duci întru întâmpinarea celor ce săvârşesc faptele dreptăţii şi îşi aduc aminte de căile Tale. Iată, Tu Te-ai pornit cu mânie şi noi eram vinovaţi prin necredinţa şi fărădelegea, noastră!
translations.grk: Συναντήσεται γὰρ τοῖς ποιοῦσι τὸ δίκαιον, καὶ τῶν ὁδῶν σου μνησθήσονται· ἰδοὺ σὺ ὠργίσθης, καὶ ἡμεῖς ἡμάρτομεν· διατοῦτο ἐπλανήθημεν,

verses.geez: ወይረክቡከ፡ እለ፡ ይትዔገሡ፡ በጽድቅከ፡ ወእለ፡ ይዜከሩ፡ ፍኖተከ።
verses.translation: and we are all become as unclean, and all our righteousness as a filthy rag: and we have fallen as leaves because of our iniquities; thus the wind shall carry us away.

translations.lxx: and we are all become as unclean, and all our righteousness as a filthy rag: and we have fallen as leaves because of our iniquities; thus the wind shall carry us away.
translations.kjv: Thou meetest him that rejoiceth and worketh righteousness, those that remember thee in thy ways: behold, thou art wroth; for we have sinned: in those is continuance, and we shall be saved.
translations.ron: Toţi am ajuns ca necuraţii şi toate faptele dreptăţii noastre ca un veşmânt întinat. Noi toţi am căzut ca frunzele uscate şi fărădelegile noastre ne luau ca vântul.
translations.grk: καὶ ἐγενήθημεν ὡς ἀκάθαρτοι πάντες ἡμεῖς, ὡς ῥάκος ἀποκαθημένης πᾶσα ἡ δικαιοσύνη ἡμῶν· καὶ ἐξεῤῥύημεν ὡς φύλλα διὰ τὰς ἀνομίας ἡμῶν· οὕτως ἄνεμος οἴσει ἡμᾶς.

verses.geez: ወኮነ፡ ርኩሳነ፡ ኵልነ፡ ከመ፡ ፀርቀ፡ ትክቶ፡ ኵሉ፡ ጽድቅነ፤ ወተነገፍነ፡ ከመ፡ ቈጽል፡ በእንተ፡ ኃጢአትነ።
verses.translation: And there is none that calls upon thy name, or that remembers to take hold on thee: for thou hast turned thy face away from us, and hast delivered us up because of our sins.

translations.lxx: And there is none that calls upon thy name, or that remembers to take hold on thee: for thou hast turned thy face away from us, and hast delivered us up because of our sins.
translations.kjv: But we are all as an unclean thing, and all our righteousnesses are as filthy rags; and we all do fade as a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, have taken us away.
translations.ron: Nimeni nu chema numele Tău şi nici unul nu se deştepta ca să se întărească întru Tine. Căci Tu ai ascuns faţa Ta de la noi şi ne-ai lăsat în voia fărădelegilor noastre.
translations.grk: Καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ ἐπικαλούμενος τὸ ὄνομά σου, καὶ ὁ μνησθεὶς ἀντιλαβέσθαι σου· ὅτι ἀπέστρεψας τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἀφʼ ἡμῶν, καὶ παρέδωκας ἡμᾶς διὰ τὰς ἁμαρτίας ἡμῶν.

verses.translation: And now, O Lord, thou art our Father, and we are clay, all of us the work of thine hands.

translations.lxx: And now, O Lord, thou art our Father, and we are clay, all of us the work of thine hands.
translations.kjv: And there is none that calleth upon thy name, that stirreth up himself to take hold of thee: for thou hast hid thy face from us, and hast consumed us, because of our iniquities.
translations.ron: Şi acum, Doamne, Tu eşti Tatăl nostru, noi suntem lutul şi Tu olarul, toţi lucrul mâinilor Tale suntem!
translations.grk: Καὶ νῦν Κύριε, πατὴρ ἡμῶν σὺ, ἡμεῖς δὲ πηλός, ἔργα τῶν χειρῶν σου πάντες.

verses.geez: ወይእዜኒ፡ አንተሰ፡ እግዚእነ፡ ወአቡነ፤ ንሕነሰ፡ ጽቡር፡ ወአንተ፡ ፈጠርከነ፡ ወተግባረ፡ እደዊከ፡ ኵልነ።
verses.translation: Be not very wroth with us, and remember not our sins for ever; but now look on us, for we are all thy people.

translations.lxx: Be not very wroth with us, and remember not our sins for ever; but now look on us, for we are all thy people.
translations.kjv: But now, O LORD, thou art our father; we are the clay, and thou our potter; and we all are the work of thy hand.
translations.ron: O, Doamne! Nu Te mânia pe noi foarte şi nu-ţi aduce aminte la nesfârşit de fărădelegea noastră! Priveşte, căci noi toţi suntem poporul Tău!
translations.grk: Μὴ ὀργίζου ἡμῖν σφόδρα, καὶ μὴ ἐν καιρῷ μνησθῇς ἁμαρτιῶν ἡμῶν· καὶ νῦν ἐπίβλεψον, ὅτι λαός σου πάντες ἡμεῖς.

verses.geez: ወፈድፋደሰ፡ ኢትትመዐዐነ፡ ወኢትዝክር፡ ለነ፡ ኃጢአተነ፡ ወይእዜኒ፡ ነጽረነ፡ እስመ፡ ሕዝብከ፡ ንሕነ፡ ኵልነ።
verses.translation: The city of thy holiness has become desolate, Sion has become as a wilderness, Jerusalem a curse.

translations.lxx: The city of thy holiness has become desolate, Sion has become as a wilderness, Jerusalem a curse.
translations.kjv: Be not wroth very sore, O LORD, neither remember iniquity for ever: behold, see, we beseech thee, we are all thy people.
translations.ron: Cetăţile Tale sfinte au ajuns pustii, Sionul este ca un deşert, Ierusalimul ca un loc pustiit!
translations.grk: Πόλις τοῦ ἁγίου σου ἐγενήθη ἔρημος, Σιὼν ὡς ἔρημος ἐγενήθη, Ἱερουσαλὴμ εἰς κατάραν.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ንኅረ፡ መቅደስከ፣፡ ወጽዮን፡ ከመ፡ መዝበር፡ ኮነት፡ ወኢየሩሳሌም፡ ለመርገም።
verses.translation: The house, our sanctuary, and the glory which our fathers blessed, has been burnt with fire: and all our glorious things have gone to ruin.

translations.lxx: The house, our sanctuary, and the glory which our fathers blessed, has been burnt with fire: and all our glorious things have gone to ruin.
translations.kjv: Thy holy cities are a wilderness, Zion is a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.
translations.ron: Templul nostru sfânt şi mărit în care Te-au preaslăvit părinţii noştri a ajuns pradă focului Şi toate cele scumpe nouă, dărâmături!
translations.grk: Ὁ οἶκος τὸ ἅγιον ἡμῶν, καὶ ἡ δόξα ἣν εὐλόγησαν οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν, ἑγενήθη πυρίκαυστος, καὶ πάντα ἔνδοξα ἡμῶν συνέπεσε.

verses.geez: ቤተ፡ መቅደስከ፡ ውዕየ፡ በእሳት፣፡ ክብርነ፡ ዘባረኩ፡ አበዊነ፣፡ ወወድቀ፡ ኵሉ፡ ትርሲትነ።
verses.translation: And for all these things thou, O Lord, hast withholden thyself, and been silent, and hast brought us very low.

translations.lxx: And for all these things thou, O Lord, hast withholden thyself, and been silent, and hast brought us very low.
translations.kjv: Our holy and our beautiful house, where our fathers praised thee, is burned up with fire: and all our pleasant things are laid waste.
translations.ron: Poţi Tu oare să Te stăpâneşti, să taci, Doamne, şi să ne întristezi atât de mult?
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπὶ πᾶσι τούτοις ἀνέσχου Κύριε, καὶ ἐσιώπησας, καὶ ἐταπείνωσας ἡμᾶς σφόδρα.

verses.geez: ወበዝንቱ፡ ኵሉ፡ ተዐገሥከነ፡ እግዚኦ፡ ወአርመምከ፡ ወአኅሠርከነ፡ ፈድፋደ።

translations.kjv: Wilt thou refrain thyself for these things, O LORD? wilt thou hold thy peace, and afflict us very sore?
